'''Ise Pev Trin''' was a lead design analyst of an [[Unidentified Iokath species|unknown species]] from [[Iokath]] who worked with master designer [[Vel Jyc Boer]]. Ise Pev Trin worked on [[Test environment Z17AX558]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ise Pev Trin is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' in the codex entry 'History of Iokath: Entry 2'.<ref name="Codex" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1stm}}
